scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c red,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json && tsc -b client
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && vitest run api
